---
title: "F&Q"

This page collects common setup and workflow questions.

## Installation and Startup

### Where do I download Neuralyzer?

Use the latest release from GitHub:
[Download Latest Release](https://github.com/paulmthompson/WhiskerToolbox/releases/latest)

For platform-specific steps, see [Getting Started](getting-started.qmd).

### The app opens, but I am not sure what to do first. What should I load?

A practical first workflow is:

1. Load media (video or image stack).
2. Load one or more features (points, masks, lines, events, or intervals).
3. Confirm TimeFrame alignment in Data Viewer.
4. Use transforms to derive analysis-ready features.

For tutorials, see [Learning Resources](learning-resources/index.qmd).

## Data and Workflows

### What if my modalities use different sampling rates or clocks?

Use explicit TimeFrames and assign each feature to the correct time base.
Neuralyzer is designed to handle cross-modal synchronization across
TimeFrames.

See [TimeFrame](concepts/timeframe.qmd).

### Where should I edit labels versus inspect traces?

Use this rule of thumb:

- Media Viewer for spatial edits (points, lines, masks).
- Data Viewer for timeline interpretation across signals/events/intervals.
- Data Inspector for table-centric curation and export workflows.

See [Interacting with Your Data](concepts/interface_roles.qmd).

### How do I keep my workflow reproducible?

Keep source and derived outputs in separate keys, and write transform
results to new keys.

See [Non-Destructive Workflows](concepts/no_write_access.qmd).

## Troubleshooting

### Quarto says "quarto" command is not recognized in PowerShell

Use the full executable path:

`"C:\Program Files\Quarto\bin\quarto.exe" render`

If needed, update PATH for the current shell session.

### Why do I sometimes see PowerShell "NativeCommandError" text during render?

PowerShell can wrap native stderr output as an error record even when
rendering succeeds. Check the actual process exit code and whether output
files were created.
